sections.title: Service identification
paragraphs: Service Coeliaque is a software application operated and maintained by Solutions BenSoft.
This Privacy Policy describes how information is handled when using Service Coeliaque.

sections.title: Information we collect
paragraphs: The only information required to create an account is a valid email address and a username (display name).
No sensitive personal information such as legal name, address, date of birth, banking, or medical data is required.

sections.title: User-provided content
paragraphs: Any data, text, documents, or content voluntarily entered by the user into the application is provided under the user’s sole responsibility.
Solutions BenSoft does not verify, validate, or assume responsibility for user-provided content.

sections.title: Local storage and offline data
paragraphs: Service Coeliaque may store certain data locally on your device to enable offline functionality.
Clearing browser data, reinstalling the application, changing devices, or device loss may result in irreversible data loss.

sections.title: Payments
paragraphs: Payments and subscriptions are processed by third-party payment providers.
Solutions BenSoft does not store or process payment card information.

sections.title: Use of information
paragraphs: Information is used solely for authentication, service functionality, and communication related to Service Coeliaque.
No personal information is sold or shared for advertising purposes.

sections.title: Data security
paragraphs: Solutions BenSoft implements reasonable technical measures to protect information.
However, no system can guarantee absolute security, and use of the service is at your own risk.

sections.title: Data retention
paragraphs: Account-related information is retained only for as long as the account remains active or as required by law.
Users may request account deletion, subject to legal or operational retention requirements.

sections.title: Policy updates
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time.
Continued use of the service may require acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: Governing law
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy is governed by the laws of the Province of Québec and the applicable federal laws of Canada.
